column1: # ZAP baseline-scan rule overrides for DevilsVault
# Format: <rule-id>\t<action>\t<name>
# Actions: IGNORE = suppress entirely, WARN = report but don't fail
# Downgrades below are for known noise in a dev/SPA context:
# 10038 – Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
#   The SPA is served by nginx-unprivileged with default headers.
#   CSP will be added in a future hardening pass; not a high-severity risk.

column3: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set

column1: # 10020 – X-Frame-Options Header Not Set / Multiple X-Frame-Options Header Entries
#   Spring Security sets X-Frame-Options: DENY for API responses. The nginx
#   frontend container does not set it yet; this is a MEDIUM at most and
#   planned for a follow-up config change.
# 10021 – X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing
#   The nginx frontend doesn't set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff by default.
#   This is informational for static assets served with correct MIME types.
# 10036 – Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field
#   nginx-unprivileged leaks "nginx/<version>" by default. Cosmetic; will be
#   suppressed via server_tokens off in a follow-up.
# 10037 – Server Leaks Information via "X-Powered-By" HTTP Response Header Field(s)
#   Spring Boot may expose X-Powered-By; this is informational only.
# 10049 – Storable and Cacheable Content
#   ZAP flags cacheable responses from the SPA; expected behaviour for
#   static assets behind nginx.
# 10054 – Cookie without SameSite Attribute
#   XSRF-TOKEN cookie is issued by Spring Security with SameSite=Lax via
#   CookieCsrfTokenRepository. ZAP sometimes flags cookies it cannot
#   attribute; downgrade to WARN.
# 10055 – CSP: Wildcard Directive
#   Related to 10038; no CSP header is set yet so ZAP infers a wildcard.
# 10098 – Cross-Domain Misconfiguration
#   CORS is intentionally configured for the SPA origin in SecurityConfig.
# 10109 – Modern Web Application
#   Informational alert that the target is an SPA; not a security finding.
